cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.18)

# Shared, arch-agnostic sources live in ../common; the per-(weight, activation)
# up-projection instantiations are generated by the parent CMakeLists into
# ${FUSED_MOE_GENERATED_UP_SRCS}. Compile both sets (with this backend's XE2
# flags) into fused_moe_xe2 via EXTRA_SOURCES.
file(GLOB FUSED_MOE_COMMON_SRCS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../common/*.cpp")

add_xe2_kernel_library(fused_moe_xe2 INCLUDE_CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR EXTRA_SOURCES
                       ${FUSED_MOE_COMMON_SRCS} ${FUSED_MOE_GENERATED_UP_SRCS})
